channel.title: Tags :: Gonemaster
channel.description: This directory contains per-module tag catalogs for gonemaster. Each catalog lists all tags that can be emitted by a module’s testcases, together with the default severity level, which testcase(s) emit the tag, and the i18n coverage status across the supported locale files.
